transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Yeah… thanks. I guess I’m here because I haven’t really been feeling like myself lately. It’s probably not as bad as it sounds, but I’ve kind of stopped doing the things I used to do—hiking, coaching, playing guitar. I don’t really call people back much anymore either.

Some days I’m just in my rental, sitting there for hours, and I know there are things I should be doing, normal stuff, but I just… can’t seem to get myself started. I don’t know if that makes sense.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?

I don’t know if I’d call it depressed, exactly. I mean… maybe a little flat, I guess. I’m not trying to be difficult—I just don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. It’s more like I’m not as interested in things, and I kind of sit around, but I’m not sure if that’s the same as feeling down.
Have you been feeling sad or down most days?

Not… not sad most days, I don’t think. I mean, I have off days, sure, but I wouldn’t want to say I’m walking around sad all the time. It’s more like… kind of blank, or just not really getting much out of things. Does that make sense?
Did this start after something stressful happened in your life?

I guess… yeah, maybe. It seemed to start after the divorce, when I moved into the smaller rental. I don’t want to blame everything on that, but things have been kind of unraveling since then. That was about a year and… two months ago, I think.
Have these changes been present most days for at least two weeks in a row?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, it’s been more than two weeks, definitely. I don’t want to overstate it, but things have kind of been unraveling since I moved into that smaller rental after the divorce… about a year and two months ago. So, yes, most days, I guess that would be fair to say.
Have you felt this way continuously for at least two years?

No… I don’t think it’s been two years. It’s been going on since after the divorce, when I moved into that smaller rental place — about a year and two months ago. So, not two years, if I’m counting right.
Do you feel these changes are mainly because of the divorce?

I mean… maybe partly, yeah. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m blaming the divorce for everything, but things did start unraveling after that, when I moved into the smaller rental. That was about a year and two months ago. So… I guess it’s connected, at least in timing.
Is the divorce still causing significant stress in your life right now?

I’m not totally sure how to separate it, honestly. The divorce is… still there, I guess, in the background. I don’t want to make too big a deal of it, but it does still weigh on me some days. I wouldn’t want to say it’s the only thing, though, if that makes sense.
Since this started, have there been stretches of at least two months when you felt mostly back to your usual self?

Not really, no. I mean, I’ve had better days here and there, but since I moved into that smaller place after the divorce… it’s kind of been unraveling pretty steadily. That’s been about a year and two months now, so I don’t think there’s been a full two-month stretch where I was really back to my usual self.
Do you feel your current symptoms are mainly a reaction to the divorce?

I don’t know if I’d say mainly, no… or, I’m not sure. I mean, the divorce definitely didn’t help, and it’s hard not to connect things to that, but I don’t want to just pin everything on it if that’s not accurate. Does that make sense?
Over the past couple of weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say depressed most of the day nearly every day… I mean, I’ve had some low moments, but I don’t know if it’s that constant. Maybe I’m not explaining it right.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried a lot?

I mean… worried, sure, but I don’t know if I’d call it a lot. I’ve had some nervousness, I guess. I don’t want to overstate it. Maybe more on edge than I used to be, but… is that the kind of thing you mean?
Lately, have you been feeling hopeless?

Hopeless… I don’t know. I wouldn’t want to say it like that exactly. There are times I feel pretty discouraged, I guess, like things are hard to see clearly, but “hopeless” sounds… I don’t know, kind of strong. Maybe not, or not all the time. Does that answer it okay?
Have you noticed a change in your sleep?

My sleep? Um… I don’t know, not a big change that I can point to. Maybe some nights are better than others, but I haven’t really been tracking it. I guess I wouldn’t want to say there’s a problem if I’m not sure. Is that okay?
Have you noticed your appetite has changed lately?

My appetite… I don’t think I’ve noticed a big change, no. I mean, some days I probably don’t pay much attention to meals, but I wouldn’t say it’s clearly different. I’m not sure if that’s what you’re asking.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?

Yeah… maybe a little. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m just being lazy, because I’m not trying to be. It’s more like I don’t feel like myself. I used to hike and coach and play guitar, and I was better about calling people back. Lately I’ll just sit in my little rental for hours, knowing there are things I should do, and I just… can’t get myself started. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Lately, have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty?

Worthless or guilty… I don’t think so, not in a big way. I mean, I can get frustrated with myself for not keeping up with things, but I wouldn’t say I feel worthless. And guilt… not really, unless I’m misunderstanding what you mean.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you had trouble concentrating?

Concentrating… I’m not sure. I mean, I can follow things if I really need to, I think. Maybe I drift a bit sometimes, but I haven’t been tracking it closely. I wouldn’t want to say it’s a major problem if it’s just normal distraction, you know?
Have other people noticed that you seem slowed down lately?

I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that, no. Nobody’s said, like, “you’re moving slow” or anything. I might be a little quieter or take my time more, but I’m not sure if that’s the same thing you mean.
Before the divorce, was there ever another time in your life when you went through a similar period for at least two weeks?

Before the divorce… um, I don’t think there was a stretch like that, not that I can clearly point to. I mean, I’ve had rough patches like anyone, but I wouldn’t want to exaggerate it and say it was the same if I’m not sure. Does that answer what you’re asking?
